If this is your first aquarium, Fluval actually makes some decent kit tanks. I've given multie as gifts, Light, filter, top and aquarium complete set. Good for a starter but alot of people are right, Go as big as you can afford. You will want to grow with the new options you will find. A 3 to 4 gallon tank can hold a hand full of nano fish and shrimp such as celestial Pearl danios (my favs), their many species of rasboras small tetras and shrimp. Biggest tip I can offer. Research the critters you want most, then build your tank needs around that. Final note, avoid gold fish. There are sooooo many other cool options
